query_ground_truth.workflow_task: Manage and triage Outlook email at scale: query inbox messages, inspect bodies and attachments, reply or forward selected messages, create and organize folders, move or delete messages, download attachments, and create a calendar invite.
query_ground_truth.query: inspect email bodies and download attachments
query_ground_truth.intent: Retrieve the full content of an email message along with any attached files.

results.execution_guidance: Found 2 tools for this query. Look at the schemas to know how to use them.

toolkit_connection_statuses.description: UniSender is a simple and easy-to-use service for email and SMS marketing campaigns
toolkit_connection_statuses.status_message: No Active connection for toolkit=unisender. You MUST call COMPOSIO_MANAGE_CONNECTIONS (toolkit="unisender") to create a connection BEFORE executing any unisender tools.

UNISENDER_GET_MESSAGES.description: Tool to retrieve list of all messages with body and attachments. Use when you need complete message information including content and attachments, unlike listMessages which returns only metadata.

limit.description: Maximum number of messages to return. Default is 30. Used for pagination.

offset.description: Number of messages to skip for pagination. Must be non-negative. Default is 0.

date_to.description: End date/time for filtering messages by creation date. Format: YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM or ISO 8601.

date_from.description: Start date/time for filtering messages by creation date. Format: YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM or ISO 8601.

UNISENDER_LIST_MESSAGES.description: Tool to list all messages without body and attachments. Use when you need to browse available messages created via API or web interface.

limit.description: Maximum number of messages to return. Default is 30.

offset.description: Number of messages to skip for pagination. Must be non-negative. Default is 0.

date_to.description: End date for filtering messages by creation date. Format: YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS or ISO 8601.

date_from.description: Start date for filtering messages by creation date. Format: YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS or ISO 8601.
